reviews.title: Troublesome eSIM for the US
reviews.body:
Purchased an eSIM for the US. 
On installing the Lebara app and connecting my account the eSIM showed as being a different amount, time and data bundle than the one I paid for. Fixed by helpful chat support my but required installing eSIM again by a different route than the initial email suggested.

While in the US, the eSIM started showing ‘No internet connection’ while in good coverage, and while only halfway through the time and data package. Again, took a session with helpful chat support to ‘fix’ it - basically requiring me to toggle airplane mode on and off ‘a few times’ every time it broke - which was several times a day. 

The US eSIM package I bought also has no number. Not that unusual but worth being aware of. 

I’ve used eSIMs several times and Lebara was by far the most troublesome

reviews.title: Slow customer service
reviews.body:
I reviewed the not-working issue with lebara eSIM when I went to USA. It was so bad I had to go to holafly (infinitely better). And lebara contacted me to sort any issue or understand it. This started on the 19th September, and now I have to say, that this contact was s as useless as the eSIM. Being an user of lebara mobile in the UK, this is putting me off a bit. I cannot avoid thinking that if I had an issue with the line in uk, I would have to deal with the same questions over and over again for a 1 and a half months.
Answer to lebara: 
It is ok.. we have gone through that proccess the first time I mentioned the issue in September, and it just led to a loop of asking me for details. As mentioned, the money spent in the esim is not worth the time spent in useless emails
